items.informal_name: Coefficient of Product with Variable in Multivariate Polynomial Ring
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (s : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.coeff (m + Finsupp.single s 1) (p * MvPolynomial.X s) = MvPolynomial.coeff m p
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $, type $ \sigma $, polynomial $ p \in R[\sigma] $, monomial $ m : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} $, and variable $ s \in \sigma $, the coefficient of the monomial $ m + \delta_s $ in the product $ p \cdot X_s $ equals the coefficient of $ m $ in $ p $. Here $ \delta_s $ denotes the monomial with exponent $ 1 $ at $ s $ and $ 0 $ elsewhere, and $ X_s $ is the variable corresponding to $ s $.

items.informal_name: Multiplication by a Variable Preserves Coefficients in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : σ),
  (MvPolynomial.X n * p).coeffs = p.coeffs
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ p $ in variables indexed by $ \sigma $ with coefficients in a commutative semiring $ R $, and for any variable $ X_n $, the set of coefficients of the product $ X_n \cdot p $ is equal to the set of coefficients of $ p $. This equality holds because multiplying by $ X_n $ shifts monomials without altering their coefficients, preserving the finite set of non-zero coefficients.

items.informal_name: Multiplication by Variable Shifts Coefficients in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (s : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single s 1 + m) (MvPolynomial.X s * p) = MvPolynomial.coeff m p
items.informal_description: For any monomial $ m $, variable $ s $, and polynomial $ p $ in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $, the coefficient of the monomial $ m + e_s $ (where $ e_s $ denotes the monomial with exponent $ 1 $ at $ s $ and $ 0 $ elsewhere) in the product $ X_s \cdot p $ is equal to the coefficient of $ m $ in $ p $. This reflects that multiplying by the variable $ X_s $ shifts coefficients by incrementing the exponent of $ s $ by $ 1 $.

items.informal_name: Coefficient of $ X_s^n $ in Multivariate Polynomial is 1 if Equal or Both Zero, 0 Otherwise
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (s s' : σ) (n n' : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single s' n') (MvPolynomial.X s ^ n) = if s = s' ∧ n = n' ∨ n = 0 ∧ n' = 0 then 1 else 0
items.informal_description: For a multivariate polynomial ring over a commutative semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, the coefficient of the monomial $ X_{s'}^{n'} $ in the polynomial $ X_s^n $ is 1 if $ s = s' $ and $ n = n' $, or if both $ n $ and $ n' $ are zero; otherwise, it is 0.

items.informal_name: Coefficient correspondence in Fin(n+1) multivariate polynomial equivalence
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ} (m : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) (i : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff m (((MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n) f).coeff i) = MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.cons i m) f
items.informal_description: For a multivariate polynomial $ f $ over $ \text{Fin}(n+1) $, the coefficient of monomial $ m $ in the $ i $-th coefficient of its algebra equivalence to a univariate polynomial with coefficients in $ R[\text{Fin}(n)] $ equals the coefficient of the extended monomial $ m $ with exponent $ i $ in $ f $. Formally, $ \text{coeff}_m(\text{coeff}_i(\text{finSuccEquiv}(f))) = \text{coeff}_{m \oplus i}(f) $, where $ \oplus $ denotes monomial extension.

items.informal_name: Coefficient of x_i in Sum of Scalar Multiples is c_i
items.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (c : n →₀ R) (i : n),
  MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single i 1) (MvPolynomial.sumSMulX c) = c i
items.informal_description: For any index $i$ in $\sigma$, the coefficient of the monomial $x_i$ in the polynomial $\sum_{i \in \sigma} c_i x_i$ over the multivariate polynomial ring $R[\sigma]$ is equal to $c_i$.

items.informal_name: Coefficient of Variable Power in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (k : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff m (MvPolynomial.X i ^ k) = if Finsupp.single i k = m then 1 else 0
items.informal_description: For a multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ over a commutative semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, the coefficient of the monomial $ m $ in the polynomial $ X_i^k $ (where $ i \in \sigma $ and $ k \in \mathbb{N} $) is $ 1 $ if $ m $ equals the monomial $ X_i^k $, and $ 0 $ otherwise. Formally, $ \text{coeff}_m(X_i^k) = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } m = X_i^k, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise}. \end{cases} $

items.informal_name: Coefficient of m in p * X_s is Coefficient of m - e_s in p if s ∈ m
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (s : σ)
  (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.coeff m (p * MvPolynomial.X s) =
    if s ∈ m.support then MvPolynomial.coeff (m - Finsupp.single s 1) p else 0
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $, type $ \sigma $, monomial $ m : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} $, variable $ s \in \sigma $, and polynomial $ p \in R[\sigma] $, the coefficient of $ m $ in the product $ p \cdot X_s $ is equal to the coefficient of the monomial $ m - \text{single}(s, 1) $ in $ p $ if $ s $ is in the support of $ m $, and zero otherwise.
